text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I placed in the top five~!
Trainer, I made the board!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, that felt so refreshing~!
It's like 70 miles of pure fun!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...Still.
Taking 1st place would make me way happier, though~

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I've made up my mind, Trainer-san!
Next time, I'm taking first place!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Win it, and it's pure fun at 120 mph--!!
choice_data_list: Then we've gotta work even harder!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Because there's something even more
fun waiting for us than right now, right?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Of course I'm going to be thrilled!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'll train anywhere, for as many miles as it takes!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
A queen never hesitates!
I'll get a whole lot stronger and get my revenge right away!!
